[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.FRIENDSHIP BUTTON
Friendship Button adds a simple reusable multiplayer item that lets you choose an online friend and teleport to a safe tile beside them.
MAIN FEATURES
• Adds the Friendship Button as a custom usable item.
• Opens a simple Stardew Valley-style menu listing valid online players.
• Excludes your own character from the destination list.
• Searches the target player's left, right, upper, and lower tiles first, then searches within a three-tile radius.
• Avoids water, blocked tiles, occupied positions, and locations outside the map.
• Includes optional teleport sound and flash effects.
• Unlimited uses — there is no daily limit.
• English and Simplified Chinese translations included.
• The item is given automatically the first time each character loads a save.
REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.
• SMAPI 4.1 or later.
• No other mods are required.
INSTALLATION
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip Friendship Button.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the FriendshipButton folder directly inside your game's Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The installed folder must contain:
Mods/FriendshipButton/manifest.json
Mods/FriendshipButton/FriendshipButton.dll
Do not place the folder inside another FriendshipButton folder.
HOW TO USE
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load a multiplayer save.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Hold the Friendship Button in your active inventory slot.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press the game's Use Tool control.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Choose an online friend from the menu.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]You will be moved to the nearest safe tile beside that player.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If the item is lost, enter this command in the SMAPI console:
friendshipbutton_give
MULTIPLAYER NOTES
• Only players who want to actively use the button need to install the mod.
• Players without the mod can still appear as teleport destinations.
• An unmodded player cannot use a gifted Friendship Button. Their game has neither the custom item data nor the code required to open the menu.
• If several players want to teleport independently, each of them must install the same version.
CONFIGURATION
The config.json file contains:
EnableTeleportEffect
Enables or disables the teleport sound and flash effect.
AllowTeleportToFarm
Controls whether players may teleport to friends currently on a farm map.
The mod has no daily usage limit.
SAFETY AND FAILURE HANDLING
Teleportation is cancelled without consuming the item when:
• the save is not in multiplayer mode;
• no other valid player is online;
• the selected player disconnects;
• farm destinations are disabled;
• no safe destination tile can be found.
COMPATIBILITY
Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.1+.
The Android SMAPI port is experimental, so controller and touch behavior may vary between launcher builds. Please include your game version, SMAPI version, control mode, and relevant log lines when reporting an Android issue.
CREDITS
Created by cj3343.
